verdict.rationale: Clerk's first-party docs describe Enterprise SSO that lets users sign in with their IdP credentials, naming Azure AD (Entra), Okta and Google Workspace, with user data synchronized into Clerk. The docs also state that Enterprise SSO supports both SAML and OIDC, so every element of the story is claimed. missing for 10: configuration and setup detail (per-IdP connection steps, domain verification, provisioning behavior), plan or tier availability of enterprise connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the SAML/OIDC connections work as described.
